newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 95/96 rice planting acreage down 6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan 95/96 rice planting acreage down 6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's rice planting acreage is expected to amount to 1.98 million hectares in the 1995/96 crop year ending October, down by 6.2 percent from the previous crop year, the Agriculture Ministry said on Thursday.
The expected decline is due to the government's efforts to cut production after bumper harvests over the past few years.
"After a bumper rice crop both in the 1994/95 and the 1993/94 crop years, we were forced to take steps to cut rice production," a ministry official said.

Average rice yield per ten ares (1 hectare=100 ares) in the 1995/96 crop year is expected to be 512 kilogrammes, up three kilogrammes from the previous year, supported by favourable weather conditions in most regions, the ministry said.
